label: Manual 2-FSK fixed CRC16 frame
about: Supply the symbol grid, two tone frequencies, byte order and payload length. Noncoherent tone projections produce decisions or erasures. Fixed frames carry a big-endian CRC16 (poly 0x1021, init 0xFFFF, xorout 0, unreflected). Validation covers that checksum under these manual assumptions; synchronization and device/business identity are not established. At most 64 frames per selection.
stage.tones: Manual symbol grid and tone decisions
conclusion.manual: Symbol boundaries and tone assumptions are manual. Tone separation is not a calibrated confidence or hardware quality report.
frame.label: Fixed candidate frame
frame.scope: CRC16 checked under the supplied fixed length, bit order and manual symbol grid; business meaning, device identity and automatic synchronization remain unknown.
issue.parameter: Enter a value within the allowed range for the complete recovery configuration.
issue.unknown: This recovery provider does not declare the supplied parameter.
issue.tones: Supply two different tones strictly inside the input Nyquist interval.
issue.partial_symbol: Only part of this symbol is inside the selected input.
issue.missing: The expected symbol contains missing input or an unknown continuity boundary.
issue.low_power: The observed power does not meet the supplied normalized RMS threshold.
issue.ambiguous: The two tone projections do not meet the supplied separation threshold.
issue.bit_erasure: The corresponding symbol has no accepted bit decision.
issue.partial_byte: Fewer than eight candidate bits are available for this byte.
issue.byte_erasure: At least one bit in this byte has no accepted decision.
